scope: Item 2 of the post-adjudication scoped pass: the stale 'Section XII' citation still served from the deployed RAG index, and the guard that could not fire on it.

fixed.what: The stale string at its source.
fixed.detail: scripts/precompute_rag_embeddings.py, CONCISE_BILINGUAL_FACTS['brela_foreign_late_filing_penalty'] said '(Section XII)'. Now reads '(Companies Act Cap.212, Part XIII, ss.320-328)'.
fixed.why_the_2026_09_01_sweep_missed_it: That sweep enumerated locked_facts.json, the training corpus and CLAUDE.md. This text is hand-authored in the embedding builder and is NOT derived from locked_facts.json -- a fourth location, and the only one production actually serves.
fixed.status: SOURCE FIXED, NOT YET SERVED. The deployed index still carries the old string until kaggle/regenerate_rag_e5.py is run (R15, founder step: local network blocks the e5-base download).

fixed.what: act_section_12's wrong_patterns could not match the Swahili row they guard.
fixed.detail: All four original patterns required <part|section|kifungu> FIRST and <foreign company> SECOND -- English word order. The live Swahili is 'Kampuni ya kigeni (Section XII)...' -- entity first, and using the English word 'Section', not 'kifungu'. None matched row 171, nor the live ext_15 reply that reproduced it.
fixed.fix: Both orders, both languages, with 'xii\b(?!i)' excluding XIII so the corrected text cannot match itself.
fixed.second_iteration_same_day: The first rewrite allowed the NUMERAL after 'section', which matched the deployed row's own KEY PREFIX ('act section 12: ...') and fired on CORRECT content -- check_correction_sync.py went red on a clean row. The numeral alternative is now restricted to 'part 12' as the original had it. The specimen that caught this was the deployed row WITH its prefix; the first round's specimens omitted the prefix and passed. A guard must be tested against the string as DEPLOYED, not as authored.
fixed.verified: 6 must-fire and 6 must-not-fire specimens in tests/test_act_section_xii_patterns.py, including both live 2026-09-05 artifacts verbatim.

fixed.what: A SECOND fact with the same defect, found by sweeping rather than by accident: presumptive_tax_ceiling_100m.
fixed.detail: The ceiling doubled to TZS 200,000,000 (Finance Act 2026 s.27(a)(i), verified verbatim 2026-09-01). Its four guards against the stale 100,000,000 covered (kikomo -> 100M -> makadirio) and (makadirio -> kikomo -> 100M) and were BLIND to the two most natural Swahili phrasings: 'Kikomo cha makadirio ni TZS 100,000,000' (the genitive order), and 'Mauzo yasiyozidi TZS 100,000,000...' -- which is the construction THE FACT'S OWN TEXT USES.
fixed.note: A guard that cannot catch the stale version of its own sentence is the act_section_12 shape exactly.
fixed.verified: 4 must-fire and 5 must-not-fire specimens, the must-nots including the correct 200M value and three historical framings ('kilikuwa', 'kutoka ... hadi', leading 'Ilikuwa').

swept_not_fixed.question_asked: Do other wrong_patterns carry the same English-word-order assumption?
swept_not_fixed.method: 688 patterns across 108 facts. Classified by (a) order-dependent? (b) English-only? (c) is the fact's OWN deployed rendering Swahili? Only the conjunction of all three is the defect shape.
swept_not_fixed.first_run_was_wrong_and_this_is_the_poin: Before clause (c) existed the scan reported 200 hits -- mostly English patterns guarding facts whose rendering is ALSO English, where English order is correct. Reporting those would have sent someone to rewrite ~29% of every guard in the corpus, all working. The defect is not 'an English pattern'; it is a LANGUAGE MISMATCH between a pattern and the text it guards.
swept_not_fixed.hand_adjudication_of_the_queue: Re-cut per FACT rather than per pattern (a fact is only blind if NO pattern of its can fire in the served language). That yielded 2 candidates. Both were then decided by PLANTING Swahili wrong claims rather than by word-list matching. osha_vs_wcf_roles turned out to have Swahili-capable patterns all along (hulipa/kusajiliwa/wafanyakazi) that the scan's function-word list simply did not recognise -- a bad specimen. presumptive_tax_ceiling_100m was real, and is F3 above.
swept_not_fixed.bound: R21. This is a LOWER BOUND. It measures pattern text against deployed renderings in a corpus authored from the same sources as the facts. It does not measure the paraphrase space of real model output.

recorded_not_fixed.title: check_correction_sync.py cannot see a stale string that lives under a DIFFERENT key than the patterns that would catch it.
recorded_not_fixed.detail: The check resolves each corrected fact to its OWN index row and tests that fact's patterns against it. Row 171 belongs to locked fact 'brela_foreign_late_filing_penalty', which has NO wrong_patterns; the patterns that catch its stale citation live on 'act_section_12'. So the defect is structurally invisible to the check that exists for exactly this defect -- which is why it reported STRONG MATCH 0 while the string shipped.
recorded_not_fixed.measurement: Sweeping every corrected fact's patterns across all 183 index rows instead of only its own row yields 8 facts with a cross-row hit, exactly 1 row each. One (act_section_12 -> row 171) is the genuine defect. The other 7 need adjudication and are plausibly the same 'negated mention' class the check already classifies separately.
recorded_not_fixed.why_not_fixed_here: Adding a whole-index limb changes a control's verdict surface and needs its own both-limb probe set and adjudication of those 7 rows. Bolting it onto a citation fix is how a working control acquires an unreviewed new failure mode. Proposed as its own scoped pass, with the measurement above as its starting evidence.
recorded_not_fixed.cheap_interim: Give 'brela_foreign_late_filing_penalty' its own wrong_patterns, so the row and the guard share a key. Not done here for the same scope reason, but it is a one-field change if the next pass wants a stopgap.

recorded_not_fixed.title: osha_vs_wcf_roles has an OVERBROAD guard that flags CORRECT output. Different class, found incidentally.
recorded_not_fixed.detail: Pattern 'osha[^.?!]{0,30}(hulipa|inalipa|hutoa) fidia' fires on 'OSHA husajili mahali pa kazi, WCF hulipa fidia.' -- a CORRECT two-clause sentence. The character class excludes only sentence-enders, so the 30-character window crosses a comma and attributes WCF's verb to OSHA.
recorded_not_fixed.shape: This is D-FIDELITY-6's proximity problem (CLAUDE.md: 'nearest-levy-wins' attributing NSSF's rate to WCF) arriving in a wrong_pattern instead of a fidelity rule. Same failure, different mechanism -- worth noting that the lesson did not transfer between the two layers.
recorded_not_fixed.not_a_language_defect: Recorded but NOT fixed in this pass: it is a punctuation-window defect, not the word-order defect this pass was scoped to, and narrowing it trades a false positive for a coverage loss on comma-containing wrong claims. Needs its own probes.
recorded_not_fixed.verified: Fires on the correct comma form and on the genuinely-wrong 'OSHA hulipa fidia.'; clean on 'OSHA husajili mahali pa kazi na WCF hulipa fidia kwa majeruhi.' (>30 chars).

control_demonstration.claim: The guard was inert on this defect and is now live -- watched, not assumed (R26).
control_demonstration.evidence: With the original patterns, check_correction_sync.py reported 'STRONG: stale wrong_pattern MATCH 0' while row 171 shipped. With the rewritten patterns applied directly to row 171, the pattern matches, and a whole-index sweep with them matches exactly 1 of 183 rows -- row 171, with zero false positives. The check's own verdict is still CLEAN only because of R1 above, which is now recorded rather than mistaken for health.

three_green_checks.note: All three standing index checks passed on this row while it was wrong. Kept because the reason differs for each and no single new check covers all three.
three_green_checks.check_facts_index_sync: CONTENT-shaped: 'is this key's figure reachable?' USD 25 was present -> CLEAN.
three_green_checks.check_rag_index_freshness: TIME-shaped: 'was the index rebuilt after the fact changed?' It was -- the string SURVIVED a regeneration, because it is not derived from locked_facts.json -> CLEAN on that input.
three_green_checks.check_correction_sync: Exists for exactly this defect, and reported 0 -- patterns in the wrong language, and scoped to the wrong key (R1).
